The '''Merthian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Osarian]], [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]] and [[Tazan]].
